tenderSchedule.locationName: North Western Karnataka Road Transport Corporation Head Office

tenderAddress.blockNumber: All the Divisions of NWKRTC located in Hubballi, Dharwad, Belagavi, Chikkodi, Bagalakote, Gadag, Haveri, Sirsi and Regional Work Shop, Hubballi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall satisfactorily meet all the pre-qualification terms and conditions and submit all the pre-qualification bid documents in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal (KPPP) as detailed in the tender document to pre-qualify for this tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder has to submit the test reports of the quoted brand conforming to the tender specifications from any of the reputed laboratory namely, CIRT/ARAI/NABL accredited State /Central Government owned laboratory

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Quality approved certificate from the reputed laboratory

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the supply and Quality performance are not satisfactory in respect of previous / past supplies, the offers of such firms will be disqualified

All ASRTU Rate Contract sources are eligible to participate in the tender. OR Manufacturers with a minimum annual average turnover of Rs. 1.50 Crore for the preceding continuous three years i.e. for 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 are eligible to participate duly supported by the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing / Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the above Criteria

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should also submit GST registration certificate issued by department of Commercial Tax.

Any bidder from a country which shares a land border with India will be eligible to bid in the tender only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority. In this regard, a compliance certificate/ declaration to be submitted by the bidder on Rs. 20/- & above stamp Paper as per the format at Declaration-III (regarding restrictions on public procurement from bidders of such country/ countries which shares a Land Border with India.)

Tenderers who have been blacklisted by any of the Government Organization/Public sector undertaking for breach of contract shall not be considered. The bidder should undertake to supply the ordered quantity as per the delivery schedule provided. The Tender must fulfill all the statutory requirements.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Duly signed Environment Safety Data Sheet
